fusions.name: Many Small Mouths
fusions.desc: A swarm of bites that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, rising by 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Barb Left Behind
fusions.desc: Fires a barb at the first enemy in a line up to 6 tiles away, usable only on a target at or below 30% health. It deals 22 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Humming Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm of fleas for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Idle
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 2% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
